pageCache.text:
Rooted in Faith, Growing in Community, Thriving in Learning.
Welcome to our website. I hope it will give you a flavour of our wonderful school, John Keble Church of England Primary School serving the communities of Hursley, Ampfield, Chandler's Ford and Winchester. We are very proud of our school, our children and their successes.
As a church school, the Christian faith underpins all that we do in school. We strive to ensure that our children are happy and confident individuals who demonstrate the school’s core Christian values of Love, Trust, Forgiveness
We aim to provide your child with the experiences, knowledge and academic skills to inspire them to become successful life-long learners. We want our children to be the best they can be and above all be kind this is underpinned by our vision, ‘’Love one another as I have loved you.” John 13: 34
We actively encourage parents to become involved in their children’s education. Our school is well-resourced with talented and committed staff. Working together as a family, we can ensure that children are both happy and successful.
If you haven’t had the opportunity to visit our fabulous school, or would like to know more, please do contact us.
Amber Vidler | Headteacher
Rooted in Faith, Growing in Community, Thriving in Learning
Vision & Values
Get to know us better
© 2026 | Legal Information
Website design by Greenhouse School Websites
Looking for a school where your child won’t get lost in the crowd?
At our school, every child is known, supported and encouraged to thrive in a calm and nurturing environment.
We warmly invite you to visit us and see our school in action:
Meet our friendly staff and pupils
Explore our vibrant classrooms
Experience our outdoor learning and forest school
Discover a school where children feel confident and valued
A small school with a big heart
We are proud to offer a caring, welcoming environment where every child is supported to grow in confidence and develop a love of learning.
We can’t wait to welcome you and your child to our school family!

pageCache.pageTitle: John Keble Church of England Primary School - Our vision, Ethos and Core Values
pageCache.text:
Our vision, Ethos and Core Values
At John Keble Church of England Primary School, we entwine our 4 strong Christian Values with our 5 learning values so that our school is a happy, safe place where we want to come together every day, learn from each other and be the best person we can be.
Every child and adult, in our whole School community, is supported to learn to love themselves and each other, taking responsibility for our actions along the way.
We teach the value of hope, knowing that there is light in every dark moment, building resilience and learning to be resourceful when times get tough.
Learning to show trust and forgiveness and be ready to commit to what we understand to be right and true, reflecting on what we can do differently next time.

pageCache.pageTitle: John Keble Church of England Primary School - Prospective Parents
pageCache.text:
Prospective Parents
Welcome to John Keble Church of England Primary School
Rooted in Faith, Growing in Community, Thriving in Learning
At John Keble, we pride ourselves on being a small school with a big heart, where every child is valued and nurtured to thrive. Our learning environment is inclusive, creative, and aspirational, encouraging children to become confident, curious learners who are not afraid to take risks and explore new ideas.
We foster strong learning behaviours through our 5 Rs:
These qualities prepare our pupils for success both in school and beyond.
Rooted in our Christian values of Love, Hope, Trust, and Forgiveness, we create a caring community where every child feels supported and inspired. Our close links with the village and local church enrich our curriculum and strengthen our sense of belonging.
At John Keble, children learn in a stimulating environment that celebrates individuality while promoting collaboration and respect. We believe education should be a joyful journey—one that sparks creativity, builds character, and nurtures ambition.
Come and see us in action! Call the school office on 01962 775241 to book a tour and discover why John Keble is the perfect place for your child to grow.
